# 524Tracker

> Browser-based tools for organizing credit-card application dates, annual fees, inquiries, and commonly reported issuer application rules.

## Core tools
- [Chase 5/24 Tracker](https://524tracker.com/): Calculate a rolling 24-month card count from dates entered in your browser
- [Card Tracker](https://524tracker.com/card-tracker): Organize card application history locally on your device
- [Spend Tracker](https://524tracker.com/spend-tracker): Track welcome-offer spending progress locally
- [Velocity Checker](https://524tracker.com/velocity-checker): Compare dates with commonly reported issuer timing rules
- [Annual Fee Calculator](https://524tracker.com/annual-fee-calculator): Compare an annual fee with benefits you value
- [Card Value Calculator](https://524tracker.com/card-value-calculator): Estimate annual net card value from your own assumptions
- [Inquiry Tracker](https://524tracker.com/inquiry-tracker): Organize hard-inquiry dates by bureau

## Reference and trust pages
- [Rules Guide](https://524tracker.com/rules-guide): Plain-language overview of commonly reported application rules
- [Methodology](https://524tracker.com/methodology): How community data points and limitations are handled
- [Privacy Policy](https://524tracker.com/privacy): Browser-local storage, analytics consent, hosting, and advertising status
- [Terms of Service](https://524tracker.com/terms): Important accuracy and financial-information limitations

## Important limitations
- Issuer rules and card terms can change without notice and are not approval guarantees.
- Verify current terms directly with the issuer before making a financial decision.
- Tracker entries are stored in browser localStorage and can be lost when browser data is cleared.
- The site has not been approved for Google AdSense and does not currently load AdSense ads.
